'''Valorum's shuttle''' was an [[Eddicus-class planetary shuttle|''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle]]<ref name="SW CVD" /> used by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] to greet [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] when she arrived on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode I" />
